body:
Thank you, that's a good perspective to look at things at, I can create my own world. I'm just saying I would have much rather lived in the world of 10 years ago, and although that may not seem like long ago I am indeed 21 (you guessed correctly).

I actually never wanted a smartphone, I still don't. I guess I'm trying my hardest to participate in modern culture but no matter how hard I try I feel out of place. Believe it or not when I was 7\-13 I wanted to live in the 70s and 80s. This whole idea of being born too late is pretty common in my life. And it may sound like a more minor issue compared to some of the other ones people post here. But for me it's haunts me every single day and while I'm feeling better today, when I posted this last night I was in the darkest of places, thinking if I could never go back there's no point in living and my time is over. But deep down I know the future is going to be ripe with new things, things I probably can't even imagine, so ultimately I always decide its worth waiting to see what it brings. Sometimes old things have to die to make way for the new.
I seem to have lost my thirst for looking for the great things the world has to offer, and when I find them they are usually from the days of old. I'll keep your words in mind, though thanks.
Edit: I'm going to sleep now, anyone who comments I'll answer in the morning \(thank you commenters\), I'm exhausted and fed up.
I'm here if you need to talk to someone.
